column1: # Expected executed-test deltas for the GBRA-47 test/eval/CI wave (X2).
# scripts/ci-executed-counts.ts compares the executed test identities of a
# baseline run with a head run. Identity = (lane, file, test, arm). Every base
# identity that no longer executes in head must match a row below, or the
# comparison fails and prints the row to add. New tests need no row.
# Columns (tab-separated; \t, \n and \\ escape a tab, newline or backslash):
#   lane      identity lane: unit, serial, slow, verify, e2e, backend-matrix,
#             tier1, tier2, jsonb-parity, shared-skills (job rows: the CI
#             artifact name that no longer exists, * allowed, e.g. receipts-slow-eval)
#   file      test file (exact; verify checks use "verify")
#   test      full test name ("describe > test"), or * for every test in the file
#   arm       backend arm (postgres-direct, pgbouncer) or empty; * matches any
#   new_lane  move only: lane the test runs in now (empty = unchanged)
#   new_file  move only: file the test lives in now (empty = unchanged)
#   new_test  move only: new test name (empty = unchanged; with test=* names stay)
#   reason    why the identity stops executing here (required, never TODO)
#   evidence  retire only: the Retiring-a-test row, e.g.
# A move passes only when the target identity executes in head; a skip row
# (planned pass-to-skip) passes only when head reports the test skipped.
